title: ui/src/JourneyStatus.tsx is not rendered by the shipped UI
body: No production module under ui/src imports JourneyStatus.tsx; the only reference is tests/unit/ui_journey_opportunity_leads.test.ts, which loads it through ssrLoadModule. Either mount it in the UI it was written for or delete it with its test so the component surface reflects what ships. Found by a knip pass on 2026-09-05 and confirmed by grep.
